title: Research: sharp A8 simplex nine-term decoder copy floor 72 (no new kappa)
body:
PR1224 left the exact optimum of its A8 simplex one-sided nine-term decoder open after bounded annealing. This scoped structural result proves that **the sharp copied-information cost on P120 is 72**, for arbitrary complex per-root kernel shifts. An explicit decoder with all nine terms active attains costs `(1,8,9,9,9,9,9,9,9)`. No new kappa or physical supplier is claimed.

The new argument studies binary deficiency spaces. The complete census of 43,435 two-dimensional spaces forces every other column's deficiency to dimension at most one. Their forced constraints have rank one or seven; the rank-one edge labels are independent, and none of the 36 apparent eight-partner cases is mutually compatible. This bounds the total deficiency by nine. The written argument covers every complex shift assignment; it is not a failed finite search or a formal multiplication proof.

Only `research/a8-simplex-decoder-floor/` is added. The selected frontier, `upstream/` and predecessor packages are unchanged. The fixed-frame P120 result does not cover P112, other frames, two unrestricted factors, masked identities or shared-copy billing. Its sharp ratio 3/5 is worse than the standard P112 copy ratio 4/7; no complete recurrence or physical-realization price is claimed.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/a8-simplex-decoder-floor/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/a8-simplex-decoder-floor/independent.py
python3 -I -B research/a8-simplex-decoder-floor/test_package.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/a8-simplex-decoder-floor --check-only
```

Primary and separate geometric replays pass, including all 14,400 all-pairs entries, the complete plane classification, six semantic controls and eight package tests. The second checker reconstructs standard 8D E8 geometry and the exact predecessor frame, uses unrelated Gram-derived label coordinates, and imports no primary or predecessor code. Optimized isolated relocation, read-only replay, changed/missing/incomplete receipts and a changed source fixture are tested. The repository research workflow tests pass (20 tests, one pre-existing environment skip), as do selected-record integrity and whitespace checks.

Local validation: macOS arm64, CPython 3.14.7. Python 3.12 generic execution, hosted CI, Lean and the complete selected-supplier cold replay are explicitly unrun. All inherited all-size, realization, hosting, precision/recovery, analytic and bit-interface obligations remain.

### Provenance and coordination

Base `dd6403f774a0891093a006ae9716c02e371b1fdb`; PR1224 source head `00e6ed0810b8ebc7f6133e2c036d0f1c9a3a4162`. Original OS seed 47, structural decoder track. [Claim #1241](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1241). The final overlap check covered 843 open PRs and 16 discussion records; this adds the exact fixed-frame optimum to PR1224, not its existing normal form.

Credit joaqcoo / PR1224 for the frame, ratio classes, deficiency perspective and open question; DreamingOfClouds / PR717, PR595 and PR446 for the decoder/cost model; themilkman216 / PR968 and woklerx / PR1077, PR1180 for surrounding floor results; and classical E8/A8 geometry. Precise pins, next questions and limitations are in the package.

Prepared for Philipp / @mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in research, proof, both implementations, verification and writing. Separate AI implementation is not independent human review. Apache-2.0.
